# Maison Tavo catalogue and care

Maison Tavo is a cookware concept rooted in Indian kitchens. Forge explores stainless steel vessels and sets. Chulha explores terracotta forms for everyday cooking. Read each product record for the current dimensions, availability, and claim status.

## Storefront
- About Maison Tavo: https://maison-tavo.myshopify.com/pages/about
- Catalogue: https://maison-tavo.myshopify.com/collections
- Kansa care companion: https://maison-tavo.myshopify.com/pages/kansa
- Protocol explorer: https://maison-tavo.myshopify.com/pages/ucp

## Agent discovery
- Agent manifest: https://maison-tavo.myshopify.com/agents.md
- Catalogue guide: https://maison-tavo.myshopify.com/llms.txt
- Shopify business profile (GET): https://maison-tavo-9pyrkr0c.myshopify.com/.well-known/ucp
- Shopify Storefront Catalog MCP (POST): https://maison-tavo-9pyrkr0c.myshopify.com/api/ucp/mcp

Use the business profile to confirm which capabilities Shopify advertises. Catalog calls need a reachable UCP agent profile. Kansa and Mol-Bhav examples in the explorer are simulations.
